name: chatgpt-codex-imessage-plugin
description: Read, search, triage, and send iMessages through a local macOS helper.

interface.shortDescription: Use iMessage from local ChatGPT Work and Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connect local ChatGPT Work and Codex sessions to Messages on this Mac through an isolated, permission-aware helper with allowlisted reads and native confirmation before every send.
defaultPrompt: Review my recent iMessages and flag replies I owe.
Search my iMessages for a phrase.
Draft and send an iMessage after I approve it.
